title: Amendment 01 to the GRUT lattice-QED preregistration: rerun P-A and P-B with a DMRG/MPS solver
what_has_been_seen_before_writing: ED results N<=24 (P-A miss +3.3%, P-B miss +9.9%), already reported as misses and NOT superseded
solver validation vs ED (4 cases, rel <= 2e-13) and the wall-clock time of one N=96 point; no DMRG gap at production size was inspected
solver: TeNPy 1.1.1 two-site DMRG, Sz=0 sector, exact Gauss-law MPO of bond dim 6 (schwinger_mps.py); excited state by orthogonal_to ground state; chi_max 120, svd_min 1e-12
validation_gate: DMRG must reproduce ED gaps to rel<1e-5 at 4 cases (validation_vs_ed.json); PASSED before this file was written
convergence_check: largest-N point at each mass rerun with chi_max 160; |delta omega| reported

recipe.finite_size_primary: omega^2 = M^2 + b/L^2 + c/L^3 on all 4 L
recipe.continuum_primary: M(x) - 2m = B + alpha/sqrt(x) + beta/x on x in {9,16,36,64}
recipe.reported: primary value; min-max spread over all 4x3 combinations

pass_rule: PASS iff |primary - target|/target <= 0.03. Whether the target lies in the spread is reported separately and does not change the verdict.
failure_handling: Misses are reported as misses. The ED misses remain on record; this amendment adds a second, independently registered test and does not overwrite the first.
